dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: IFT-12 Targets May 12 After Booster 19 Full 33-Engine Static Fire; Ship 39 V3 Stacked on OLP-2 — CRS-34 Also Launches May 12; IPO S-1 ~8 Days Out
heroSubtitle: 8,770 days of SpaceX milestones — Booster 19 completed a full 33-engine Raptor 3 static fire at OLP-2 on May 9, clearing IFT-12 for a May 12 launch target (5:30 p.m. CDT, Starbase). The OLP-2 water deluge system was repaired in fewer than 5 days — far faster than the 2–3 week estimate from May 7 — enabling one of the fastest turnarounds from a pad explosion to static fire in SpaceX history. Ship 39 (first Block 3 V3 upper stage, 124.4 m combined height) is fully stacked; FAA launch license is the sole remaining gate. CRS-34 Cargo Dragon launches from SLC-40 Cape Canaveral on the same day (7:16 p.m. EDT, ~6,500 lbs to ISS), potentially making May 12 the first day in history with two SpaceX orbital-class launches simultaneously. SpaceX IPO public S-1 expected May 18–22 (~8 days away); Nasdaq debut targeting June 18–30 at $1.75T valuation.
